hazards.dismiss-community: You dismissed the neighbourhood's monitors as noise. On a site whose contractor data was found unreliable, the community's independent record is the control, not a courtesy.
hazards.no-consent: You chose to collect a biomonitoring sample first and explain later. A person's hair, urine or blood is theirs; informed consent, in their language, with the right to say no and to get their own results back, comes before any tube is opened — that is the rule under 45 CFR 46 and the foundation's own practice.
hazards.speak-for-org: You presented this simulator as the foundation's own programme. It is a training aid offered to them; their programmes are theirs to describe, and putting words in their mouth is exactly what a community organisation spends its life correcting.
hazards.walk-in: You treated an active Superfund parcel as open ground. Parcels are behind fences and institutional controls; a community monitor works from the public side of the fence unless trained, badged and escorted.

steps.cue: Pick the statement that matches the foundation's own record.

options.label: Arieann Harrison, Executive Director, who founded it in honour of her mother Marie Harrison
The Navy's community relations office, as part of the cleanup programme
The City of San Francisco's Department of Public Health

steps.prompt: Pick the statement that matches the foundation's own record.
steps.title: Who founded and leads the Marie Harrison Community Foundation?
steps.why: Who an organisation is decides whose training this is. A community foundation founded by a resident in her mother's name is accountable to the neighbourhood first; a training aid offered to it has to know that before it says a word about the site.

steps.cue: Pick the description that matches the sourced record.

options.label: A resident of Hunters View whose community campaign helped close the PG&E Hunters Point power plant in 2006, later a Greenaction advocate who kept testifying while on oxygen
The Navy's radiological contractor's community liaison
A university scientist who ran the shipyard's monitoring programme

steps.prompt: Pick the description that matches the sourced record.
steps.title: Who was Marie Harrison?
steps.why: The story is the reason the work exists. A neighbour who worked at the shipyard as a young woman, lived beside the power plant, helped shut it down and testified on oxygen until her death is why the foundation measures its own air — and why its patrols log what they smell.

steps.cue: Select every programme that is the foundation's — order doesn't matter.

decoyNotes.p-navy: Radiological clearance of parcels is the Navy's job under EPA and state oversight, not a community foundation's. The foundation monitors, screens, educates and holds the process to account.

options.label: Community Pollution Patrol Network
Hunters Point Biomonitoring Initiative
Marie Harrison Community Foundation Academic Scholarship
Solutions for Women
Radiological clearance of shipyard parcels

steps.prompt: Select every programme that is the foundation's — order doesn't matter.
steps.title: Which programmes does the foundation run?
steps.why: The twenty-five stations of this edition are organised around these programmes: a patrol station trains what a patrol does, a biomonitoring station trains consent and custody, a scholarship is why the youth stations exist. Knowing the programmes is knowing the syllabus.

options.label: Ten air monitors placed in and around Bayview Hunters Point by the community project named for her
None — the neighbourhood relies on the Navy's on-site instruments
A few hobby sensors whose data should be disregarded on a regulated site

steps.title: What is the Marie Harrison Bayview Air Monitoring Project?
steps.why: A low-cost sensor network is only as good as its siting, its co-location checks and its data review — which is why three stations of this edition are about exactly that. The point of the project is that the neighbourhood holds its own record, and the point of the training is that the record stands up.

steps.cue: Pick the order the programme requires.

options.label: Explain the study in the resident's language, confirm they can decline and will get their own results back, get signed consent, then collect under chain of custody
Collect the sample while they are willing and go through the paperwork afterwards
A verbal yes at the door is enough for a hair sample

steps.prompt: Pick the order the programme requires.
steps.title: A resident agrees to join the biomonitoring initiative. What comes first?
steps.why: Biomonitoring turns a neighbour into a study participant. Informed consent under 45 CFR 46 — the study explained, the right to refuse, the right to their own results — is the ethical floor, and chain of custody is what makes the result mean anything when it comes back.

steps.cue: Pick the response the patrol trains.

options.label: Log time, place, wind, what you smell and see, take a photo, and file the complaint with the Air District — then keep patrolling
Go through the site gate to find whoever is responsible
Walk onto the parcel to photograph the source up close

steps.prompt: Pick the response the patrol trains.
steps.title: On patrol you smell solvent downwind of a fenced parcel. What does a patrol member do?
steps.why: A patrol is a record, not a raid. A timed, located, photographed, wind-noted observation filed with the Air District is evidence an inspector can act on; a body inside the fence is a trespass and an exposure, and it puts the patrol's credibility at risk.

steps.cue: Pick the statement that matches the 2026 record.

options.label: An active Superfund site since 1989 under the Navy with EPA and state oversight; the contractor data case settled in 2026 while the residents' 2024 federal suit over the cleanup's adequacy continues
A completed cleanup, transferred to the city
A private redevelopment with no federal role

steps.prompt: Pick the statement that matches the 2026 record.
steps.title: Where does the site record stand?
steps.why: Everything a community monitor does happens against an unfinished record: parcels still under cleanup, litigation still open. Saying that honestly is the first thing a patrol lead owes a new member.

steps.cue: Pick the role the record supports.

options.label: As an independent check on the site's own record, made credible by siting, calibration checks, chain of custody and honest data review
As anecdote — only the regulators' instruments count
As a replacement for the regulators' monitoring, which can then stop

steps.prompt: Pick the role the record supports.
steps.title: How should community data be treated on this site?
steps.why: Neither dismissed nor oversold. Community data earned its standing here because the official data failed; it keeps that standing only by being done carefully, which is what the sensor, dust and sampling stations of this edition teach.

options.label: A 40-hour HAZWOPER course, three supervised field days and an annual refresher, plus the site's own orientation — the trades on site are LIUNA laborers, IUOE operators, Teamsters and radiation technicians
A site badge and a toolbox talk
Patrol experience counts as site training

steps.title: What is the training gate from community patrol into paid cleanup work?
steps.why: This edition ends with the pathway: patrol members and scholarship students who want the work behind the fence go through the same federal floor as every union laborer on the site. 29 CFR 1910.120 is the gate, and the site orientation sits on top of it.

options.label: A training aid built to be offered to the foundation and its partners, sited generically, that does not speak for the foundation
The foundation's official training programme, describing its work on its behalf
The Navy's community outreach curriculum

steps.title: What is this Hunters Point Edition?
steps.why: The last unsafe conclusion is about us. A simulator that claims to be a community organisation's own voice takes something that is theirs. This edition is offered; what the foundation says about its work, including its CLEAR page, is for the foundation to say.
